descricao: Even though the level has a dark environment, there appears to be an unknown phenomenon that affects many wanderers by making them feel "relaxed" and "calm" despite the fact that there are hordes of Smilers lurking everywhere. The effect mostly takes place whenever any wanderers start focusing on the sea breeze coming from the bay. This is thought to be a ruse to get you to lower your guard and become unaware that danger and hostile entities are already in your proximity. Eventually, the effect was officially named and known as the "Painless Death".
